conventions: The short divine name יָהּ (Np) in the Hallelujah formula (vv. 1, 9) is its own unit aligned to 'Jehovah'; the ASV margin 'Hebrew Hallelujah' is read and set aside (rule 38), and the imperative keeps 'Praise ye' as in the long-form 'Praise ye Jehovah'.

Verses 7 and 9 open with a bare Hiphil participle (מְקִימִי, מוֹשִׁיבִי) whose subject is the יְהוָה of v. 5, outside the verse. The ASV's supplied 'He' is added in both (rules 10, 20, 25; 1SA.2.8 precedent for this very phrase); the participle takes only its own lexical verb and any phrasal particle or supplied preposition rule 44 gives it. The ASV's 'And' between the two cola of vv. 4, 7 and 9 answers to no waw and is added on the same terms (rule 14).
report: Read all nine verses end to end against the candidate table and the dump. No cross-verse split found; every difference in the table is one the ASV's rendering licenses.

הַ Td→Ncmpa: v4 'the heavens' aligned, v6 'in heaven' and v9 'of children' unrepresented — the ASV writes a 'the' in one and none in the others (rules 12, 29). The v9 rectum article's 'of' is rule 19's, not the article's.

לְ before an infinitive construct: v5 unrepresented because 'hath his seat on high' writes no function word at all (rule 52's last sentences, rule 40); v6 'to behold' and v8 'That he may set' each hold a written word (rule 52). Not a split.
יהוה 'of Jehovah' (v1, v2) vs 'Jehovah's' (v3), and שֵׁם 'the name' vs bare 'name' beside the possessive, are rule 29's possessive recasting; מִן 'out of' vs 'from' in v7 are both written by the ASV.

Supplied English is consistent chapter-wide: 'And' for an asyndetic second colon is added in v4, v7, v9 (rule 14); 'He' before a verse-initial participial predicate with no nominal in the verse is added in v7 and v9 (rule 25, 1SA.2.8 precedent); 'Even' in v8 is added (rule 16); 'him' in v8 and 'his' in v5 are added (rules 44, 18).
BSB disagreements (v5 לָ, v9 הַ) are convention differences, not errors: the ASV spends no word on that לְ, and the 'of' before 'children' belongs to the rectum under rule 19.
No promotion or amendment: the chapter applies rules 14, 25, 26, 29, 36, 41, 44 and 52 as written and teaches nothing the contract lacks.
